Select molecule ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human CB2 receptor in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter assays where assay_organism is 'Homo sapiens' and target_dictionary.pref_name is 'Cannabinoid CB2 receptor'. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN on molregno and filter to include only rows where canonical_smiles is not null. Return the columns aliased as molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
